title.zh-CN: 黄疸、黑便与进行性全身衰弱

summary.zh-CN: 男孩黄疸迅速加深并出现黑便和肾功能异常，转氨酶并不显著升高，需要判断肝功能严重程度和时间紧迫性。
summary.en: A boy develops worsening jaundice, melaena and renal dysfunction despite modest aminotransferases, requiring assessment of liver failure and urgency.

provenance.citation: 莫国生, 张金龙, 吴子龙. 血浆置换联合肝移植治疗儿童肝衰竭一例. 中华儿科杂志. 2011;49(06):473-474. doi: 10.3760/cma.j.issn.0578-1310.2011.06.019.

name.zh-CN: 第三天变化与补充影像

zh-CN: 第三天变化与补充影像

text.zh-CN: 第3天出现意识不清和躁动，原文标为重度肝性脑病；MRI见双侧基底节区异常，影像并见腹水及双侧胸水。病毒病因筛查未支持所列病毒感染；无ATP7B结果。
text.en: On day 3 impaired consciousness and agitation were labelled severe hepatic encephalopathy. MRI showed bilateral basal-ganglia abnormalities, with ascites and bilateral pleural fluid on other imaging. Listed viral investigations did not support infection; no ATP7B result was supplied.

text.zh-CN: 综合治疗并六次血浆置换后意识和肾功能改善，PT仍55.5 s，随后肝移植。术后三个月总胆红素15.3 µmol/L、肌酐53.6 µmol/L、PT 13.5 s。
text.en: After combined care and six plasma exchanges, consciousness and renal function improved but PT remained 55.5 s; liver transplantation followed. At three months bilirubin was 15.3 µmol/L, creatinine 53.6 µmol/L and PT 13.5 s.

prompt.zh-CN: 低ALT是否能降低本例的紧迫性？
prompt.en: Does the low ALT reduce urgency in this case?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 不能；重度黄疸、凝血异常和肾损伤提示严重肝功能衰竭
text.en: No; severe jaundice, coagulopathy and renal injury indicate serious liver failure

feedback.zh-CN: 合成功能与器官损害比单看ALT更能反映此处危险。
feedback.en: Synthetic dysfunction and organ injury convey risk beyond ALT alone.

text.zh-CN: ALT低说明肝病很轻
text.en: Low ALT proves mild liver disease

feedback.zh-CN: 无法解释PT明显延长及严重黄疸。
feedback.en: This cannot explain markedly prolonged PT and severe jaundice.

text.zh-CN: 只需按单纯肾衰竭处理
text.en: Treat only isolated renal failure

feedback.zh-CN: 肝脏、凝血和铜代谢线索不能忽略。
feedback.en: Hepatic, coagulation and copper-metabolism clues cannot be ignored.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: K–F环、低铜蓝蛋白及整体表现支持Wilson病相关肝衰竭的临床判断，基因尚未确认
text.en: The ring, low ceruloplasmin and overall pattern support clinical Wilson-related liver failure without genetic confirmation

feedback.zh-CN: 意识恶化进一步提高紧迫性；单独铜蓝蛋白不能承担全部诊断。
feedback.en: Consciousness deterioration increases urgency; ceruloplasmin alone cannot carry the entire diagnosis.

text.zh-CN: 已完成ATP7B分子确诊
text.en: ATP7B molecular diagnosis is complete

text.zh-CN: 暂时清醒就能排除肝性脑病
text.en: Temporary alertness excludes hepatic encephalopathy

feedback.zh-CN: 后续记录有明确精神状态变化，须按时序理解。
feedback.en: Later mental-state changes require chronological interpretation.

prompt.zh-CN: 当前应怎样安排治疗路径？
prompt.en: How should the current treatment pathway be organised?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 尽早与儿童肝移植中心协作，重症支持及必要的血浆置换作为桥接评估
text.en: Engage a paediatric transplant centre early, with critical support and assessment of plasma exchange as a bridge

feedback.zh-CN: AASLD指导强调Wilson相关急性肝衰竭的加速移植评估；暂时改善不意味着病因解除。
feedback.en: AASLD guidance emphasises expedited transplant assessment in Wilson-related acute liver failure; temporary improvement does not establish cure.

text.zh-CN: 先等待所有传统保肝药都失败再转诊
text.en: Wait until every traditional liver-support drug fails before referral

feedback.zh-CN: 会浪费危重肝衰竭的时间窗。
feedback.en: This may lose the window for management of critical liver failure.

text.zh-CN: 血浆置换已能替代所有肝移植
text.en: Plasma exchange replaces transplantation in every case

feedback.zh-CN: 支持或桥接不能被单例推广为普遍根治。
feedback.en: Support or bridging cannot be generalised as cure from one case.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明低转氨酶不排除严重肝衰竭。；承认没有ATP7B检测、完整铜定量和长期移植物结局。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Low aminotransferases do not exclude severe liver failure.; acknowledge ATP7B testing, complete copper quantification and long-term graft outcomes are absent. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 原报告将肝衰竭归于Wilson病，并以血浆置换等支持桥接肝移植。
conclusion.en: The report attributed liver failure to Wilson disease and used plasma exchange and other support as a bridge to transplantation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 低转氨酶不排除严重肝衰竭。
keyReasoning.en: Low aminotransferases do not exclude severe liver failure.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 跨系统铜代谢线索支持病因评估。
keyReasoning.en: Multisystem copper-related clues support aetiological assessment.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 支持后改善与恢复肝脏合成功能不是一回事。
keyReasoning.en: Improvement after support is not equivalent to restored hepatic synthesis.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 按凝血、意识及器官损害判断危险。
teachingPoints.en: Assess danger through coagulation, consciousness and organ injury.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 原文脑病级别标签不替代具体症状。
teachingPoints.en: Historical encephalopathy grades do not replace described symptoms.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不复制旧文大量保肝处方。
teachingPoints.en: Do not reproduce the historical multi-drug prescription.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 没有ATP7B检测、完整铜定量和长期移植物结局。
unknowns.en: ATP7B testing, complete copper quantification and long-term graft outcomes are absent.
